purpose: Reduce human validation waste by distinguishing four empirically repeated blockers/mechanisms: reversible reality probing, trust/access orchestration, boundary translation, and service-routing residue. These are search priors and falsification rules, not new business categories.

evidence: Peixian Zhongyi Food tested frozen whole-duck export at the end of 2025; after the first shipment succeeded, overseas orders followed into Cambodia, Afghanistan, Angola and Guinea. Public reporting states Q1 2026 frozen-duck exports exceeded 600 tonnes and were 4.65x the prior full-year amount.
XCMG/Huaneng/Huawei's autonomous electric mining-truck route moved from an initial nine-unit trial in 2023 to a 100-unit cluster in 2025 and then another 100-unit procurement agreement in 2026.

Xuzhou's SME digitalization program explicitly favors small, fast, lightweight, precise solutions and pilot-first replication, while provincial scene policy supports early validation and small-batch sample trial production.

Xuzhou cross-border policy is pushing industrial belts from large-batch standardized output toward small-batch, personalized and customized overseas orders; at least one local export manufacturer publicly supports 500-5,000-unit trial orders for rapid iteration.
findings.interpretation: When a real exchange can be made sufficiently small, reversible and observable, the cheapest truth source may be a bounded real transaction rather than more research or interviews.
boundaries: A free or cheap trial is not automatically low-friction: an OPC founder reported that prospects would not even accept free use before trusted access/case credibility existed.
Do not use a reality probe where regulatory, safety, privacy, capital-loss or reputational downside is not meaningfully bounded.
A probe is useful only if its outcome is interpretable; a failed sale with unknown traffic, trust, pricing and product-fit causes is weak evidence.
findings.formation_014_implication: Before buying or building a Local Context Sensor, compare it with the cheapest reversible market probe. Sensor value survives only where a direct small-batch/listing/trial is too costly, slow, unsafe, irreversible, or cannot answer the decision cleanly.

evidence: A Xuzhou OPC founder with a working low-code product reported lacking brand endorsement and customer cases; prospects would not engage even with free trial. After the university entrepreneurship park helped frame the project and connect real demand-side firms, he obtained orders from two enterprises.

Xuzhou entrepreneurship-park reporting states many creators' first orders come from enterprises previously incubated by the park, showing the park functions as a trusted access node rather than only office space.

A Xuzhou technology manager found a manufacturer that could only say its drill electro-hydraulic control system 'did not work well'; she translated the complaint into a technical demand list and matched a China University of Mining and Technology hydraulics team in under a week. One technology-manager office reportedly facilitated eight technical contracts worth nearly RMB 2 million in 2024.
Xuzhou's scene system similarly supplies access, rules, feasibility review and resource coordination, with 285 scene projects reported landed in roughly one year.
findings.interpretation: A latent A/B fit can remain blocked even when price is zero. Trust, permission, case credibility and a legitimate introduction path are resources in their own right. The orchestrator does not create demand; it lowers connection risk and makes interaction permissible/credible.
boundaries: Do not build another generic matchmaking layer where parks, technology managers, chain leaders or scene platforms already perform the role. Search their uncovered residue instead.
findings.formation_007_implication: Public evidence currently supports access/credibility/problem-legibility as stronger OPC blockers than the hypothesized 'senior commercial judgment' edge. Hold 007 below field promotion until a real OPC actor shows a post-access, post-demand-definition commercial failure where senior judgment—not access, trust, case proof or task clarity—is the missing edge.

evidence: The technology-manager case turns an enterprise's vague symptom into a structured technical demand that an expert can search and act on.
Xuzhou's scene policy explicitly calls for standardized demand-collection templates with clearer descriptions and technical parameters before supply-demand matching.
Local-context-sensor evidence shows foreign-market signals must be translated into product parameters, packaging, configuration, sales or channel decisions to become economically useful.

Xuzhou's public enterprise-request stream repeatedly contains cases where firms say they do not know how to complete certification, credit repair, permit changes, project procedures or other specialist/regulatory processes even though relevant professional or government capabilities exist.
findings.interpretation: Some apparent missing connections are representation failures, not missing supply. A useful translator converts symptoms, lived context or business consequences into a form the capability-side actor can evaluate, and converts specialist constraints back into decision language.
boundaries: Where technology managers, professional institutions, platform templates or internal specialists already perform translation adequately, the route is not whitespace.

evidence: The Xuzhou comprehensive enterprise-service platform currently reports 20,382 handled requests and more than 310,000 registered users.

Its anonymized typical requests repeatedly include credit repair, financing, quality-system certification, safety guidance, recruiting, factory-space, staff commuting/housing/children schooling, fire acceptance, utilities and regulatory procedures.

The same current platform exposes professional-service institutions including quality-management, accounting/tax, technology/management consulting and legal-service providers, in addition to integrated government, finance, talent and technology-service systems.
A separate `/home` rendering still sometimes reports no professional-service content; this is treated as a UI/index inconsistency, not evidence of market absence.
findings.interpretation: Repeated requests in a world where relevant supply exists suggest a possible discovery, trust, representation, bundling or exception-routing residue. Public request text alone does not reveal whether the firm searched the market, rejected providers on price/trust, needed government authority, or faced a truly exceptional case.
findings.next_truth: Sample repeated same-shaped cases and determine the pre-request path: what was tried, why ordinary service failed, who had authority to resolve it, time/cost of workaround, and whether the successful resolution used market supply, administrative authority, or both.

evidence: A Xuzhou OPC founder publicly describes using AI to provide multilingual overseas-market expansion support for local electric-tricycle manufacturers and reports already receiving two orders.
This joins existing local platform, compliance, logistics, advertising and overseas-warehouse services as evidence that 014 must not regress into translation or generic overseas-operation support.
findings.interpretation: Language conversion is already a callable paid capability locally. Any surviving 014 edge must provide a decision-relevant local fact that translation, standard provider packages and a cheap reversible trial do not already answer.

mechanism_ordering_for_discovery: First test whether the apparent gap is only a representation problem that an existing boundary translator already handles.
Then test whether access/trust/permission rather than capability is blocking the path and whether an existing orchestrator already supplies that resource.
Then compare additional research with the cheapest safe, reversible, interpretable reality probe.
Only spend high-cost human validation when public evidence, existing translators/orchestrators and a bounded real probe cannot resolve the remaining uncertainty.
